row.notes: recordFadeMaker(frame, maker, a, b, c, d) (log SKIDMARKS_REPLAY 'ReplayFrame::recordFadeMaker (%p)'): if fade count u16 +0xa < 0x1ff appends a 4-byte record at +0x8814 {maker+0x217d, flags (bit7 from c, bit6 if maker+0x217d == d) | maker+0x2174, a, b} and type code 2 into the 2-bit stream +0x46428 (count +4, max 0x340); else logs 'c_maxFadesMade needs increasing?'. Callers Render_Skidmarks_Update. (lane owner review requested)
